import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem quotient_is_commutative_of_commutator_le {A : Type*} [Group A] (B : Subgroup A) [B.Normal] (h : _root_.commutator A ≤ B) :
  ∀ a b : A ⧸ B, a * b = b * a := by
  intro a b
  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ a b fun a b => ?_
  change QuotientGroup.mk' B a * QuotientGroup.mk' B b = QuotientGroup.mk' B b * QuotientGroup.mk' B a
  have hmem : a * b * a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ ∈ B := by
    apply h
    apply Subgroup.subset_closure
    aesop
  have hker : QuotientGroup.mk' B (a * b * a⁻¹ * b⁻¹) = 1 := by
    first
    | exact (QuotientGroup.mk'_eq_one B).mpr hmem
    | rw [← MonoidHom.mem_ker, QuotientGroup.ker_mk' B]; exact hmem
    | rw [← MonoidHom.mem_ker, QuotientGroup.ker_mk B]; exact hmem
  have hmul : QuotientGroup.mk' B a * QuotientGroup.mk' B b * (QuotientGroup.mk' B a)⁻¹ * (QuotientGroup.mk' B b)⁻¹ = 1 := by
    simpa [map_mul, map_inv] using hker
  calc QuotientGroup.mk' B a * QuotientGroup.mk' B b
      = QuotientGroup.mk' B a * QuotientGroup.mk' B b * (QuotientGroup.mk' B a)⁻¹ * (QuotientGroup.mk' B b)⁻¹ * (QuotientGroup.mk' B b * QuotientGroup.mk' B a) := by group
    _ = 1 * (QuotientGroup.mk' B b * QuotientGroup.mk' B a) := by rw [hmul]
    _ = QuotientGroup.mk' B b * QuotientGroup.mk' B a := by group
